**Work context**

Hiren is a Senior Security Engineer at The Walt Disney Company (remote), with 20+ years of experience spanning cloud security (AWS, Terraform, IAM, WAF, CloudWatch), application security (Veracode SAST, Burp Suite/OWASP ZAP informally), detection and incident response (Splunk, Cortex XSOAR, CrowdStrike, Python automation), and identity/SSO (SAML/OIDC/SCIM). He is the founder of The Sentient Well, a personal SaaS venture with two projects: a CAR-T therapy portal (AWS Amplify, S3, React) and a behavioral health support platform (React/Next.js, Node.js, HIPAA-aligned architecture, currently in final QA). Hiren is a U.S. citizen based in Mahwah, NJ.

**Personal context**

Hiren has interests spanning fitness and body recomposition, Indian cooking and vegetarian cuisine, Vastu Shastra, gardening, and home maintenance (lawn equipment, power equipment). He is an active gamer (Elden Ring) and uses Spotify with custom theming via Spicetify. He has family and community ties connected to the Swaminarayan tradition.

**Top of mind**

Hiren is preparing for a final-round interview at Pinterest for a Security Software Engineer II – Detection and Response role, following a successful coding round; he was planning to finalize STAR stories and compile interview prep materials. His two declared strategic priorities are the Pinterest interview and The Sentient Well. He is also actively running his JobsApply multi-agent resume tailoring pipeline and has built a large library of tailored resume variants targeting companies including Anthropic, Netflix, Databricks, LangChain, Notion, xAI, OpenAI, HackerOne, and Quora.

**Brief history**

*Recent months*

Hiren has been executing an intensive job search with a structured resume system: a master source-of-truth document plus tailored variants per role, with standing guardrails applied consistently across all outputs — no formal penetration testing claims, no on-call claims, AWS only (no Azure/GCP), Python only, no ML model training claims, behavioral health platform as "in final QA" not "in production," compliance as "HIPAA-aligned" not "HIPAA compliant," and zero em dashes. He built the JobsApply local Python pipeline (Anthropic API, python-docx) to automate job parsing, fit scoring, resume customization, and Excel summary export from pasted job postings. He debugged and ran his RAG Alert Triage Harness (Ollama/llama3.1:8b, ChromaDB, Python) to produce real precision/recall/F1 metrics, identifying a reasoning-to-decision disconnect where the model correctly cited benign criteria but still defaulted to true_positive classifications. He has been conducting deep system design study, producing a 30-concept reference guide and a full interactive HTML diagram mapped to a video streaming architecture. He completed a coding interview sprint (arrays/hashing, linked lists, trees, graphs, DP) ahead of a prior interview round. He has been researching Pinterest's detection and response security practices and preparing for the role's emphasis on SIEM, EDR/Osquery, and macOS/Linux internals. He also noted Osquery and explicit macOS internals experience as gaps to address.

Hiren works at a breast center (likely a second role or family member context — mentioned performing breast ultrasound) and has engaged in extensive self-directed clinical education on breast imaging: BI-RADS categories 0–6, ACR lexicon for calcifications and ultrasound mass characterization, elastography, biopsy technique selection, dense breast tissue, and supplemental screening modalities. He has been building fitness habits around a 6-day Push/Pull/Legs program using machines (HIT-style, 2 sets to failure), tracking workouts in a custom HTML tracker with local storage history. He reached a significant weight loss milestone and shifted focus to maintenance and muscle recomposition.

*Earlier context*

Hiren built an 8-week structured AI/LLM security training plan (attack taxonomy, prompt injection, MCP and tool security, triage tool extension) as a companion to a GenAI Security Training syllabus document, after recognizing that security job postings increasingly list GenAI as a requirement. He completed portions of a Udemy "AI Engineer Agentic Track: The Complete Agent & MCP Course" covering agentic design patterns, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and MCP. He has three personal AI projects deployed on Hugging Face Spaces (Python): (1) a Document Q&A chatbot agent (RAG-style, ingests uploaded documents and answers questions); (2) an agentic tool-calling loop (single agent calling tools/APIs iteratively until task complete); and (3) a multi-model evaluator (compares outputs from multiple LLMs on the same prompt and scores them). He explored and shelved a Regulatory AI Compliance Copilot business idea due to bandwidth constraints, identifying job search and Sentient Well as his only two active priorities.

He resolved a persistent Samba/network share issue on a Raspberry Pi (missing `/run/samba` tmpfs directory on reboot), debugged a Gradio + OpenAI tool-calling agent (message format and variable scope errors), and worked through Python fundamentals and algorithm patterns (Big O, DP, greedy, two pointers, sliding window). He owns a 2023 Tesla Model Y Dual Motor and evaluated extended warranty options after factory warranty expiration.

*Long-term background*

Hiren's confirmed career background includes: Senior Security Engineer at Disney (June 2022–present); Technical Implementation Engineer at iBoss (Zero Trust/CASB, Aug 2021–May 2022); Senior Customer Success Engineer at Comodo Cybersecurity (June 2018–Dec 2020, 55+ enterprise accounts, Python/PowerShell/Bash automation for endpoint configuration, hands-on DLP policy implementation). Certifications include AWS Solutions Architect Professional, CRISC, Google Cloud Certified, CHFI v8, CompTIA Security+, MCSE, and GIAC Python Coder Training (2024). He has long-standing interests in Indian vegetarian cooking, Ayurvedic wellness practices, and community involvement in the Swaminarayan tradition. His Gujarati heritage is reflected in his surname and cultural context across several conversations.

project_memories.019f29cf-61d7-701c-bfae-af049993c3d5:
**Purpose & context**

Patel is a senior security engineering professional based in Mahwah, NJ, actively pursuing new roles while running an independent venture (The Sentient Well) nights and weekends alongside a day job at The Walt Disney Company. Two parallel goals are in motion: (1) building an agentic AI-powered penetration testing framework as a technical project, and (2) executing a comprehensive job search with tailored resumes and interview prep across multiple target companies and role tracks.

The Sentient Well is positioned as a formal Professional Experience entry (Part-Time / Independent, Nights & Weekends) to preempt conflict-of-interest concerns, with all independent projects consolidated under that single entry (including CAR-T Therapy Portal, Behavioral Health Support Platform, LLM Alert Triage Harness, Hugging Face agents, and the ai-pentest tool).

---

**Current state**

**Technical — ai-pentest framework:**
Two major versions have been built in Python:
- *V1:* Generic HTTP target connector, static payload library (prompt injection, jailbreak, data leakage categories), Claude-based judge with structured JSON verdicts, JSON/HTML report output.
- *V2:* Fully agentic architecture — AttackerAgent (LLM) that plans adversarial moves from live transcript rather than fixed payloads; upgraded judge evaluating tool/function-call invocations; goal-based categories for tool misuse and excessive agency; adaptive escalation on failure; CI integration with baseline diffing for regression detection.

Important guardrails established: only test authorized systems, require human approval gates before irreversible actions, and note that tool misuse/excessive agency categories require target-specific tool schema configuration.

**Career — resume and application pipeline:**
A master resume exists and has gone through multiple revision cycles with specific formatting issues identified and corrected (duplicate heading, missing section heading, malformed characters, detached bullet). Confirmed skills on record: Burp Suite/DAST, hands-on Okta, hands-on Palo Alto Networks products (specific product names pending).

Tailored resumes completed for: Dropbox, CoreWeave, Figma, Garner, Clay, Plaid, Hopper, Faire (with leveling gap flagged for Senior Staff role). Generic track resumes completed: Detection & Response, Application Security, Senior Security Engineer (generalist), Senior AI Security Engineer, AI Security Engineer, and a hybrid Detection & Response + Red Team/Offensive Security track (skills section leads with "Offensive Security / Red Teaming").

Interview prep built and revised for Pinterest (Security Software Engineer II).

---

**On the horizon**

- **LangChain application:** Incomplete — pending specific product names for secrets management tools and clarification on which role involved multi-tenant/access-boundary work.
- **Okta-tailored resume:** Was in queue but skipped; status unclear if still desired.
- Palo Alto Networks specific product names still needed to finalize certain resume entries.
- Potential continuation of ai-pentest development or application to new targets.

---

**Key learnings & principles**

- Honest qualification gaps are flagged directly rather than papered over — skills, tools, or certifications (e.g., Teleport, SPIFFE/SPIRE, CISSP, Go, Kotlin, SBOM/sigstore/SLSA) are not added without explicit confirmation from Patel.
- Leveling mismatches (e.g., Senior Staff roles) are surfaced clearly rather than obscured in tailored materials.
- The Sentient Well framing as part-time/independent is a deliberate structural decision to maintain professional integrity while showcasing independent technical work.
- For agentic security tooling, human-in-the-loop approval gates before irreversible actions are treated as non-negotiable design requirements.

---

**Approach & patterns**

- Resume customization follows a confirmed-facts-only discipline: each tailored version draws only from verified experience, with Claude checking back rather than assuming.
- Technical projects are developed iteratively with downloadable artifacts (Python zip packages).
- Career materials span both company-specific tailoring and reusable generic track resumes for efficiency across applications.
- Patel drives sequencing — choosing which roles to pursue, skip, or defer mid-process.

---

**Tools & resources**

- Python (primary language for ai-pentest)
- Claude API (judge/attacker agent within ai-pentest)
- Burp Suite / DAST tooling
- Okta, Palo Alto Networks products (hands-on)
- Hugging Face (agents work under The Sentient Well)
project_memories.019f3d13-5d61-77ef-ba18-afed0ec24398:
**Purpose & context**

Patel is building **SentientWell Inc.**, maker of the **CAR-T Portal** — a biotech R&D SaaS tool for CAR-T construct sequence design, codon optimization, region annotation, and validation/audit reporting. The product is positioned as **Research Use Only (RUO)**, not clinical. The target users are researchers and biotech teams working on CAR-T constructs.

> **Important correction (user-confirmed):** SentientWell is the CAR-T Portal biotech R&D platform described above. It is **not** a healthcare AI security, HIPAA compliance, or EU AI Act platform for behavioral health — that was a prior erroneous conflation with a separate, unrelated project idea and should be disregarded entirely.

Patel appears to be at the solo-founder stage, actively working toward a seed raise and MVP launch.

---

**Current state**

- The CAR-T Portal is in active development, with a defined MVP (six specific conditions) and a phased product roadmap extending 18+ months.
- A comprehensive planning document has been synthesized covering: current development status (what works vs. what is blocked), MVP definition, phased roadmap, financing plan anchored to a seed raise, and a go-to-market plan.
- Pricing tiers are established: Starter (per-user), Team (monthly flat), and Enterprise (annual).
- A **Vision section** has been defined, framing the product wedge around trust and reproducibility, with a progression from RUO research tool → shared workflow layer → CRO/partner proof-pack layer → integrated platform infrastructure.
- A competitive analysis focused on IDT's codon optimization tool has been completed.
- A 3-year financial model with Conservative/Base/Upside scenarios and quarterly burn detail is in place.

**Active challenge:** A third-party CLI tool ("lavish," fetched via `npx` from a GitHub repo) was installed via Claude Code in a separate session. Claude has flagged substantive security concerns — including full agent permissions, a local web server, high/critical risk scanner ratings, and a share command that publishes artifacts to a third-party host — which is particularly sensitive given the proprietary nature of CAR-T construct sequences. Lower-risk alternatives have been offered but a resolution has not yet been confirmed.

---

**On the horizon**

- Executing the **180-day traction plan** as outlined in the go-to-market strategy.
- Closing the seed raise.
- Resolving the tooling security concern around the lavish/axe CLI before using it with proprietary sequence data.
- A "growth opportunities" document was flagged as potentially unrelated to the CAR-T Portal — its relevance or connection to the project remains an open question.

---

**Key learnings & principles**

- The CAR-T Portal's core value proposition is **trust and reproducibility** — not just sequence design capability, but the audit trail and validation reporting that makes research defensible and shareable.
- The RUO positioning is a deliberate scope boundary, keeping the product out of clinical/regulatory complexity while still serving real research workflows.
- Third-party tooling that touches proprietary construct sequences carries elevated risk and warrants careful vetting before adoption.

---

**Approach & patterns**

- Patel works with Claude to produce structured, comprehensive planning documents (Word format) synthesizing multiple source files — pitch decks, roadmaps, financial models, competitor analyses.
- Development environment: **VS Code with Claude Code extension** as the primary build surface; **Claude.ai** (this interface) in a planning, review, and synthesis role.
- Local project root: `C:\Users\NeelKanya\Claude_Dev\sentientwell` (chosen to avoid file-locking issues); GitHub repo at `https://github.com/SentientWell/sentientwell_dev.git` with branch protection enabled.
- Context continuity across sessions is maintained via `CLAUDE.md` in the repo rather than conversation transfer.

---

**Tools & resources**

- **VS Code** with Claude Code extension (primary development surface)
- **GitHub** (`SentientWell/sentientwell_dev`) with branch protection (PRs required before merging to main)
- **Claude.ai** (this project) for planning, document synthesis, and strategic review
- Investor business plan (v6), pitch deck, roadmap, MVP task list, and competitor analysis as core reference documents
